title: Jump Jump 3D
description: Hold to charge your leap and release to land squarely on the next floating 3D pillar—chain bullseye center landings for skyrocketing combo multipliers.
controls: Press and hold anywhere on screen to charge your jump power, then release at the exact moment to hop onto the center of the next block.

zh-CN.title: 跳一跳 3D
zh-CN.description: 国民经典一指蓄力跳跃：长按蓄力、松手精准飞跃落到下一个方块中心，连续正中靶心狂飙翻倍连击高分！
zh-CN.controls: 按住屏幕蓄力控制跳跃距离，松手让小人跃向下一个方块，精准落中中心点触发高倍连击加分。
